description: Returns the Errands brief fields (required and optional, with shapes and allowed values), the rules the assistant always follows, and worked examples. Read-only. The assistant introduces itself with the name in Widely AI assistant settings (Settings → Voicemail → Configure Personal Assistant → Assistant's name). assistant_name overrides it for one errand; save_as_default true also saves it as the default. With neither, the call is refused: set it with set_assistant_name.
name: describe_errand_template
title: Describe the Errands brief
